notes: Targets are locally served OpenAI-compatible vLLM endpoints from the model-deploy stack folder outside this repo: GLM-5.3-Flash on GPUs 0-3 (host port 7999) and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next FP8 on GPUs 6-7 (host port 8002).
The judge is a fixed third model served single-GPU on the GPU free of both targets; its compose file lives in the model-deploy stack folder outside this repo. Start it before running.

The benchmark judge client only accepts HTTPS judge endpoints. For a locally served judge, terminate TLS in front of it (e.g. https proxy on 127.0.0.1:8443 forwarding to the vLLM judge port) and export NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS pointing at the terminating CA before running — the orchestrator forwards it to the benchmark runner.
apiKeyEnv names the environment variable holding each endpoint key. Key values are resolved from the environment at run time and are never written to committed files, logs, or comparison reports.

Each target's isolated runtime-data dir is wiped and re-seeded with a minimal analysis-only settings.json ({ analysis: { pythonBin } }) pointing at the shared ~/.structureclaw/.venv interpreter — without it the backend would fall back to the system python3, which lacks the analysis runtime dependencies. Override the interpreter via SCLAW_BENCHMARK_PYTHON_BIN. The file never carries LLM config; per-target model isolation flows from environment variables only.
